about: Bug Bite and Pluck feed their user the Berry they steal under Klutz and under Embargo (6ecec8f6d: before, the Berry was eaten for nothing). A level-10 Chansey at 5 HP, whose low Attack leaves the target above the half where it would eat its own Berry, is given Bug Bite and Pluck in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Embargo and holds an Oran Berry (set:). With Klutz, Bug Bite eats the Berry and heals 10; then, its own ability back, under the Embargo the wild Chansey laid, Pluck eats another and heals 10 again. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
